html:
The Ruwanwelisaya is a great white stupa at Anuradhapura in Sri Lanka, begun by King Dutugamunu in about 140 BCE to hold relics of the Buddha.

Dutugamunu came from Ruhuna in the south and defeated Elara, a Tamil king from the Chola country who ruled at Anuradhapura. The Mahavamsa tells this as a holy war and makes Dutugamunu the island's great hero. The stupa was his great work; he is said to have died before it was finished.

It is one of the largest stupas in the world. Its dome was restored in the 20th century, and with the Sri Maha Bodhi it is among the most visited shrines of Sri Lankan Buddhists.
sum: The Ruwanwelisaya is a great white stupa at Anuradhapura in Sri Lanka, begun by King Dutugamunu in about 140 BCE to hold relics of the Buddha.
